purpose: Earn food in town, reach another location, exchange it for a persistent quest item, revisit and save/reload.

setup.rng: record ordinary initial RNG state through the qualified backend; do not force later outcomes

sourceOracle.whyUnqualified: EGA source/resource match, exact commands and original reference observations have not been established for this example.

ega1989.note: Do not infer EGA trade semantics or commands from VGA.

steps.intent: Complete normal creation/arrival and earn an ordinary route to the food seller
assert: Cash and skills follow ordinary chosen creation/progression

steps.intent: Buy the edition-qualified food quantity through its normal interaction
assert: Cancel/insufficient-cash branches do not grant items

steps.intent: Walk through the required connected rooms to Brauggi
assert: Original encounter policy retained; no assisted victory qualifies

steps.intent: Attempt an oracle-qualified wrong or insufficient offering
Offer the qualified item/quantity through ordinary UI
assert: Expected dialogue/state transition and time delta

steps.intent: Leave, revisit and test the repeat/reward branch
assert: NPC and quest state remain consistent
Repeat cannot duplicate a one-time reward unless the original explicitly permits it

steps.intent: Save, reload and continue to a dependent quest milestone
assert: Inventory, clock, flags and actor/sequence state survive
Payoff remains usable through the normal interface

evidenceRequired: real UI input trace and checkpoint captures
qualificationRule: A draft with null fingerprints, missing exact inputs or an unqualified oracle must not pass an acceptance gate. This file is a specification example, not a completed test.
